understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid and complete every level by activating all goal cells. Each goal required the carried piece to have the correct shape, color, and rotation simultaneously before stepping onto it.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move consumed one stamina point, and reaching zero stamina cost a life while restoring stamina. Walls blocked movement, and blocked_directions had to be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycled shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycled colors orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotated the piece clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal activated only when all three attributes matched, and completing all goals advanced to the next level; losing all lives ended the game.
